author: nadin.dabbas
title: رسائل وعبارات تهنئة بمناسبة الكريسماس بالإنجليزي
text:
مع حلول عيد الكريسماس، تفيض الأرواح بالسلام والفرح وتتزين القلوب بالمحبة، فهو عيد يجمعنا على معاني العطاء والتسامح، ويجدد فينا الأمل ببدايات أجمل. وفي هذه المناسبة المباركة، نشارك الأحباب والأصدقاء والزملاء أرقّ عبارات التهنئة، تعبيرًا عن مشاعر صادقة تنبع من القلب، وتحمل أطيب الأمنيات بعيد ميلادٍ مجيد وسنة جديدة مليئة بالخير والمحبة.
رسائل وعبارات تهنئة بمناسبة الكريسماس بالإنجليزي
- All feelings stand to congratulate you on this occasion. Merry Christmas
- The birth of Christ visits us once again، to increase the spaces of love that connect us with people who deserve this joy
- Blessed be this joy upon you، and blessed be the joy of the new year، Merry Christmas
- Merry Christmas
- Life without you is dull and worth nothing to me. Every year you are near me، you fill my heart with warmth and happiness. Merry Christmas
- Merry Christmas to all the hearts that shared with us the details of this glorious year
- Merry Christmas May you be blessed، and to more successes for all the hearts that deserve it
- Romantic Christmas Messages
- You make my world brighter every day. Wishing you a Christmas filled with love, joy, and magical moments.
- My heart is yours this Christmas and always. Merry Christmas, my love.
- Every moment with you is a gift. May our Christmas be as special as you are to me.
- Friendly Christmas Messages
- Wishing you a Christmas full of laughter, happiness, and unforgettable memories!
- May your holidays sparkle with joy and your New Year be filled with success. Merry Christmas!
- Cheers to friendship, love, and all the amazing memories we share. Merry Christmas!
- Inspirational Christmas Messages
- May this Christmas bring peace, love, and hope into your life.
- Remember the true meaning of Christmas: kindness, love, and generosity. Merry Christmas!
- May the spirit of Christmas fill your heart and home with happiness.
- Short & Sweet Christmas Messages
- Merry Christmas!
- Wishing you joy, love, and laughter this Christmas!
- Peace, love, and joy to you this holiday season.
- Professional / Formal Christmas Messages
- Wishing you a Merry Christmas and a prosperous New Year.
- May your Christmas be joyful and your New Year successful.
- Sending warm holiday greetings and best wishes for the season.
